verdict: M212's terminal-descriptor hint is necessary and sufficient under the accepted ready/valid contract, closes only the final partial compact window, retains the authoritative done fence, and does not cross token or window ownership. Independent current-source Synopsys VCS passes hand-derived one-, three-, full-, zero-, long-stall, bank-96, and same-edge header-chain cases. Fresh and queued zero-raw-last hint cases are exact. A fresh M210/M212 256-case A/B reproduces 36 improvements, 220 unchanged, zero regressions, and the M212 recurrence has zero VCS mismatches. A fresh four-worker replay of all 5,580,000 frozen H67 FC2 tokens is byte-identical to M213. The admitted scope is an isolated sparse FC2 frontend and a logic-only pre-macro DC result, not complete FC2, FFN, physical, system, or headline speedup.

terminal_hint_logic_audit.fresh_last: PASS: one terminal descriptor remains stable for four descriptor-stall cycles and is accepted atomically with raw_last
terminal_hint_logic_audit.queued_zero_raw_last: PASS: a two-descriptor queued tail remains stable for four cycles and accepts atomically with an all-zero final raw packet
terminal_hint_logic_audit.boundary_truncation: A fresh packet truncated at an earlier compact-window boundary cannot assert the hint because it does not drain the visible source
terminal_hint_logic_audit.nonzero_queued_raw_last: A concurrent nonzero queued raw-last packet cannot assert the hint until its new descriptors drain

m213_independent_full_replay.method: Fresh four-worker execution over the pinned manifest, payload files, M212 model, validation receipt, RTL identities, and docs359 identity

p1.finding: The exact 3 ns logic-only setup path has only +0.0007 ns slack and hold is exactly +0.0000 ns under ideal clock and ZeroWireload.
p1.effect: The current result has effectively no demonstrated physical timing margin and is not paper PPA.
p1.required_action: Seal exact-SHA DC, then run Formality, propagated-clock PT, macro/SRAM integration, and physical margin closure before physical claims.

p1.finding: M212 saves 795,772 frozen isolated-frontend cycles versus M210, only 1.008803882x incrementally, while adding 0.6612% logic-only cell area.
p1.effect: This is a useful control-bubble removal and reaches the stage-0 analytic lower bound, but is not by itself a paper headline speedup.
p1.required_action: Keep the M212 delta as a mechanism ablation and compose it with an honestly matched baseline plus weight, accumulation, commit, and memory service.

p1.finding: The admitted module stops before weight service, accumulation, result commit, and physical SRAM/DRAM behavior.
p1.effect: Complete-FC2, FFN, physical, and system performance remain unknown.
p1.required_action: Keep all complete-FC2/FFN/system/headline fields false until those services share one executable cycle boundary.

p2.finding: Only 795,772 of 1,149,920 early terminal partial closes save a cycle.
p2.next_target: Localize the remaining paired-window done-fence/load boundary without relabeling coincident loads as causal savings.

p2.finding: The production M212 regression did not itself hit bank-96, a greater-than-672-cycle descriptor hold, or same-edge terminal header chaining.
p2.next_target: Promote this review's bank-96, 736-cycle hold, and current-source header-chain tests into the normal fail-closed regression.

p2.finding: DC retains signed/unsigned conversion warnings and two high-fanout nets.
p2.next_target: Make widths explicit, prove equivalence, and inspect the high-fanout physical cones in PT/place-and-route.

m214_concept_risks.risk: The RTL must use authoritative upstream_done_accept, including tag, descriptor-count, and no-descriptor checks; done_valid alone is insufficient.
m214_concept_risks.required_guard: No same-cycle load on malformed or unaccepted done.

m214_concept_risks.risk: The bypass may load only an already-closed lone pair_first and must share candidate-load group and bitmap-decrement atomicity.
m214_concept_risks.required_guard: No duplicate consumption, stale pair_second merge, pair-release collision, or token/window ownership crossing.

m214_concept_risks.risk: The opportunity model's same_cycle_done_loads counter increments for every candidate load coincident with done, including stage-0 and pair_has_two loads that were already eligible without done.
m214_concept_risks.required_guard: Do not interpret that counter as causal savings; count same_done && !old_pair_available, or use exact M214-minus-M212 cycle delta.

m214_concept_risks.risk: The done comparator to candidate-load gate is being added to a design with only 0.7 ps setup margin in the current logic-only DC run.
m214_concept_risks.required_guard: Require exact VCS calibration and clean matched DC before admitting M214; an analytic opportunity result is not RTL or physical evidence.
